11.steps: 1) Add a VPN policy on the firewall. 2) Set the Local IKE ID to Email Address. Type 10.10.10.10 in the field. Attempt to save the policy. 3) Set the Peer IKE ID to Email Address. Type test test in the field. Attempt to save the policy.
11.title: Invalid format for Email Address IKE ID
11.result: 10.10.10.10 and test test will not be accepted as Email Address type of IKE ID. After the attempt to save VPN policy having 10.10.10.10 as Local IKE ID the error message Phase1 local IKE ID is not valid will be displayed. After the attempt to save VPN policy having test test as Peer IKE ID the error message Phase1 peer IKE ID is not valid will be displayed.

21.steps: Try to ping a pc in local site to start the tunnel negotiation, check the log on firewall.
21.initial: 2 VPN policies on local firewall VPN1 == gw (0.0.0.0), remoteId -> vpn1, local network ->X0 subnet, remote network->remote1 VPN2 == gw (0.0.0.0), remoteId -> vpn2, local network ->X0 subnet, remote network->remote2 On the remote firewall configured a policy to VPN2 as RemoteVPN1 == gw( ip address of local firewall) , remoteId -> vpn2, local network ->remote1, remote network->remote X0 subnet. where remote X0 subnet is same as X0 subnet on local gateway
21.title: For 2 or more Zero gateway mis-configuard policy, Ph1 and Ph2 should establish with the same VPN policy.
21.result:
1.Phase 1 should get established to vpn2;
  2.Firewall should report error for proposal not match in phase2 to vpn2.

7.steps: 1) Add matching VPN policies on two firewalls. 2) Set the Local IKE ID ? to IP Address and Peer IKE ID to Email Address on the local firewall. 3) Set the Local IKE ID to Email Address and the Peer IKE ID to IP Address on the remote firewall. 4) Enter the WAN IP of the firewall to the Local IKE ID field and test@test.com to the Peer IKE ID field on the local firewall. 5) Enter test@test.com to the Local IKE ID field and WAN IP of a peer to the Peer IKE ID field on the remote firewall. 6) Save the VPN policies and negotiate the tunnel.
7.title: Local IKE ID is set to IP Address; Peer IKE ID is set to Email Address.
7.result: The data entered in the fields is accepted as IP Address and Email Address types of IKE ID. The VPN tunnel is negotiated successfully when using Phase1 IDs of different types.

2.steps:
1) Add matching VPN policies on two firewalls. Specify explicit IPSec gateways.
  2) Set the Local IKE ID and Remote IKE ID fields on the local and remote firewalls to IP Addresses. 3) Leave the fields empty. 4) Save the VPN policies and negotiate the tunnel.
2.title: IKE IDs are set to IP Addresses on the local and remote firewalls, the fields are not filled in
2.result: The empty fields are accepted with IP Addresses selected as IKE IDs. The VPN tunnel is negotiated successfully when using those Phase1 IDs.

17.steps: 1) Use a firewall with Enhanced firmware as a local and a firewall with 6.x firmware (old interface) as a remote box. 2) Add matching VPN policies on two firewalls. Use Aggressive Mode. 3) Set the Local IKE ID and the Peer IKE ID fields on the local and remote firewalls to SonicWALL Identifier. 4) Enter the Unique Firewall Identifier of the local firewall to the Local IKE ID field. 5) Enter incorrect data (different from UFI of a remote firewall) to the Peer IKE ID field. 6) Save the VPN policies and negotiate the tunnel.
17.title: IKE ID is using invalid SonicWALL Identifier
17.result:
The negotiation will fail in Phase1 due to invalid IKE ID. The appropriate log message wil be generated.
  Note: The term old interface in this case refers to a firmware with an old GUI that was released prior to SonicOS2.0.
  Since that is no longer applicable use remote firewalls with 5.9 and 6.1.x released firmware.

20.steps:
1. Downgrade one of the firmware to lowver version, for example, if you are testing 5.6, you can downgrade one FW to 5.5.1.0_5o
  2. Configure a S2S VPN policy, configure matched Local IKE ID and Peer IKE ID with IP Address Type
  3. Start negotiation by Keep alive or traffic, make sure tunnel could be successfully set up between two diffenent firmware version
